mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_event_outbox(event_id, order_id, user_id, reservation_id, payload, available_at) VALUES(#{eventId},#{orderId},#{userId},#{reservationId},#{payload},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE order_event_outbox SET claimed_by=#{worker}, claim_until=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 60 SECOND), attempts=attempts+1 WHERE published_at IS NULL AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (claim_until IS NULL OR claim_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_event_outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL AND claimed_by=#{worker} AND claim_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE order_event_outbox SET available_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL LEAST(300,POW(2,attempts)) SECOND), claimed_by=NULL, claim_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND claimed_by=#{worker} AND published_at IS NULL
UPDATE order_event_outbox SET published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), claimed_by=NULL, claim_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND claimed_by=#{worker} AND published_at IS NULL
